method: EMA seeded by SMA; RSI Wilder; MACD 12-26-9; volume SMA20

validation.one_hour_candle_policy: Regular-session candles only; exclude the separate 18:00 closing-auction bar.
validation.four_hour_candle_policy: Historical indicators use complete 08:00-12:00 and 12:00-16:00 bars; a reconciled live 12:00-16:00 in-progress bar is included and explicitly marked partial.
